# Summon_LinkChildCall_Missile — 0x5537BF

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.py. -->

簡易戦闘のミサイル経由の召喚 0x553390（ECX=スキル、親=ミサイル+0x78）内の 0x5774A0 呼び出し。スキルは呼び出し元 [esp+0x2c]（呼ばれた側 [esp+0x38]）。

- [research/recovered/outside_design1/reports/dev_lab/_work/summon_exp_20261103/kb_section9.md:6](../../research/recovered/outside_design1/reports/dev_lab/_work/summon_exp_20261103/kb_section9.md?plain=1#L6-L6) — - **Parent -> children:** parent BattleUnit `+0x178/+0x17C/+0x180` is a `std::vector<BattleUnit*>` of summoned children. The only appender is `0x5774A0(parent, child)` (stdcall, `ret 8`), which also overwrites child `+0x1E594` with parent only when that field is already nonzero. Exactly three E8 callers, each right after a summon spawn: `0x54F245` (normal summon `0x54E7B0`, child from `0x56F880`), `0x5479F0` (simple-battle summon `0x547490`, child from `0x544290`), `0x5537BF` (simple-battle missile summon `0x553390`). No writer shrinks `+0x17C`; dead children stay in the vector and are told apart by child `+0x1867C`. Earlier note: dev_lab story ON-STAND-010 already identified the vector, `0x5774A0`, `0x575A60` and `0x5445E0`; the new part is the complete caller set, the absence of removal and the absence of a reverse pointer.
